section.44: The Book of the Merits of the Companions

44.name_native: The Book of the Merits of the Companions

hadiths.text: Ibn Musayyib reported that Hassan said to a circle in which there was also Abu Huraira:Abu Huraira, I adjure you by Allah (to tell) whether you-had not heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying like this
